before: A setListLevel write changed w:ilvl and kept the paragraph's own w:ind, so an item with its own left or hanging indent stayed in place at its new level.
after: A setListLevel write that changes the level also removes the paragraph's own leading and first-line w:ind attributes in the same write; the right indent stays.
reason: Replicas exchange the resulting paragraph properties, not the op, so released readers apply the shorter w:ind like any other paragraph property change and converge on it; no new op or shared field.
